com.vector.cfg.gen.core.bswmdmodel.groovy.extensions

Class BswmdModelExtensions

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.vector.cfg.gen.core.bswmdmodel.groovy.extensions.BswmdModelExtensions

  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public final class BswmdModelExtensions
extends java.lang.Object
    This class provides extension methods for BswmdModel object like GIModelObject and other helper classes like optionals. The bswmdModel methods are the same as in the API interface IBswmdModelApiEntryPoint.

      • activeViewWith

        @PublishedMethod
public static <T extends GIModelObject,R> R activeViewWith(T bswmdModelObject,
                                                                             @DelegatesTo(strategy=1)
                                                                             groovy.lang.Closure<R> code)
        The method activeViewWith(Closure)} executes the Closure code under visibility of the GIModelObject.getCreationModelView() of this GIModelObject. You could use this method, if you want to return an object from this operation. 

         
 GIModelObject myModelObject = ...;

 ReturnType returnVal = myModelObject.activeViewWith { theModelObject ->
   // do some operations
  }
        Type Parameters:
        T - the generic type of the BswmdModelObject
        Parameters:
        bswmdModelObject - the bswmd model object
        code - the code to execute
        Returns:
        Returned object of the closure code
        See Also:
        IModelViewManager.executeWithModelView(IModelView)

      • bswmdModel

        @PublishedMethod
public static <CFG extends com.vector.cfg.model.mdf.model.autosar.ecucdescription.MIHasDefinition,BSWMD extends GIModelObject> BSWMD bswmdModel(CFG self,
                                                                                                                                                                  WrappedTypedDefRef<?,CFG,?,BSWMD> defRef)
        Returns the found bswmd object from the passed MDF model object.

        This allows you to access the BswmdModel by MDF model objects in a generic way, without knowing a DefRef. This is handy, if you want traverse an unknown Ecu configuration structure.

        Note: If you know a DefRef please use the other methods like IBswmdModelApiEntryPoint.bswmdModel(MIHasDefinition, WrappedTypedDefRef) instead!

        Type Parameters:
        CFG - the MDF model type
        BSWMD - the bswmd model instance type
        Parameters:
        self - the MDF model object to use
        defRef - an definition of the passed MDF object.
        Returns:
        The found bswmd object

      • getUserAnnotations

        @PublishedMethod
public static IUserAnnotationList getUserAnnotations(@Nonnull
                                                                       GIModelObject self)
        Return the list of UserAnnotations of the BswmdModel element. See GroovyMdfHasAnnotationExtensions.getUserAnnotations(MIHasAnnotation) for details. The returns IUserAnnotationList will respect the GIModelObject.getCreationModelView() of the used model object. This means all IUserAnnotations will be viewed with the creation IModelView.
        Parameters:
        self - the bswmd model object
        Returns:
        the list of IUserAnnotations
        See Also:
        GroovyMdfHasAnnotationExtensions.getUserAnnotations(MIHasAnnotation)
